questions.solution_text:
For each $x$ in the common domain $-1\le x\le1$, the arcsin and arccos ordinates add to $\frac{\pi}{2}$.
At $x=-1$, the sum is $-\frac{\pi}{2}+\pi=\frac{\pi}{2}$; at $x=0$, it is $0+\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{\pi}{2}$; at $x=1$, it is $\frac{\pi}{2}+0=\frac{\pi}{2}$.
The sketch is the horizontal segment $y=\frac{\pi}{2}$ for $-1\le x\le1$, including both endpoints.
